newsitem.title: UK: UK waterborne freight traffic rises 2 percent in 1995.
newsitem.headline: UK waterborne freight traffic rises 2 percent in 1995.

text.p: The volume of waterborne freight traffic in Britain rose two percent in 1995 to 143 million tonnes, the Department of Transport said on Thursday.
Traffic on inland waterways accounted for four percent of waterborne freight movements, coastwise traffic accounted for 77 per cent and one-port traffic 19 per cent.
The statistics cover traffic carried by both inland craft (barges) and seagoing vessels along the inland waterway system and around the coast of Britain.
